call_points.text: Management maintains 15-16% average EBITDA margin target as sustainable
Geopolitical risks in MENA region continue to impact export volumes
Management expects low double-digit volume growth for FY27 if overall demand stays firm.
NBR capacity expansion to almost double capacity will come on stream in Q1FY28.
Board approved setting up a new R&D center with an outlay of ₹20 Cr to ₹25 Cr.
All plants operated at 90% to 100% capacity utilization during Q4FY26.
Q4 employee expenses include ₹14 Cr provisions for LTI, pending litigation, and gratuity policy changes.
Recognized ₹4 Cr impairment on Valia turbine accessories and ₹2 Cr additional depreciation from asset life review.
Closed Strait of Hormuz disrupted Middle East feedstock imports, requiring Chinese sourcing and raw material inventory coverage through June.

operating_notes.text: Completed acquisition of 5.12% stake in Opera Vayu (Narmada) Private Limited for ₹3.38 Cr for captive hybrid power consumption.
FY26 operating cash flow reached ₹203.44 Cr, representing 201% of net profit.
Nitrile latex revenue accounts for 15% to 20% of total top line.
Middle East sales (including Egypt, Turkey, UAE, Saudi) contribute ~12% to total top line.
Plant utilization ran at 90-100% across factories in Q4FY26.
Initiated capacity expansion project worth ₹210 Cr towards Nitrile Rubber and Synthetic Latex.
Inventory gains contributed approximately 2% to EBITDA growth in Q1FY27
Export volumes fell 10-12% YoY due to geopolitical disruptions in MENA region
Domestic volumes grew 10% YoY, offsetting some export decline
Q2FY27 raw material cost was 73.0% of revenue versus 69.3% in Q2FY26, a 371 bps increase
H1FY27 capex of ₹66.74 Cr was 215.9% higher YoY, funding the NBR and synthetic latex expansion
Company has no subsidiary, associate or joint venture as on September 30, 2026; only one business segment (Synthetic Emulsion Polymers)

Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹397.58 Cr (+13.8% YoY), net profit ₹34.74 Cr (+107.4% YoY).
Apcotex Industries Limited hosted the earnings conference call audio on 7th May 2026 for Q4FY26 and FY26 results, available at https://apcotex.com/investor-quarterly-report.
Apcotex Industries reported Q4FY26 transcript highlighting low double-digit FY27 volume guidance, ₹14 Cr line provisions, and ₹20-25 Cr R&D capex plan.
Apcotex Industries issued a communication to shareholders regarding tax deduction at source on the proposed final dividend for FY25-26.
Apcotex Industries published its June 2026 investor presentation detailing FY26 results and a ₹210 Cr capex plan.
Apcotex executes agreement to acquire 1.27% stake in Amplus Ampere for ₹0.72 Cr
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹498.92 Cr (+48.2% YoY), net profit ₹34.84 Cr (+37.7% YoY).
Audio recording of earnings conference call held on 29 October 2026 is hosted on the company website.
